coverage.summary: Applies only to Protected Units. All RSO units are Protected Units. Other units qualify if, within the past five years, they were under an affordability covenant or rent/price control or were rented by lower or very low income households, or if they were withdrawn under the Ellis Act within the past 10 years.
coverage.other_conditions: Enhanced RPO relocation applies only where the Protected Unit is occupied by a lower-income tenant (80% of AMI or below). Otherwise the regular RSO/JCO rules apply.

result.notes: Two items were removed from other_conditions because they describe landlord conduct, not unit or owner scope: the 5-year window between demolition and the withdrawal/eviction filing, and the demolition-for-new-construction trigger. The summary now lists the Protected Unit categories exactly as given in the D043 footnote. The earlier claim that 'JCO units can be Protected Units under the lower-income occupancy test' was replaced, because no document states it in those terms. The construction cutoff stays null: the RPO is not limited to RSO (pre-10/1/1978) buildings, so that cutoff does not define its coverage.
